name: Mar de Jade
tradition: Soto Zen (annual Rohatsu sesshin), hosted at a general wellness resort
teacherAccess: Daily, direct, during the Zen sesshin week
retreatOptions: The Zen retreat runs approx. 5-7 days; other resort programs run 3-14 nights
about: A 35+-year-old beachfront retreat property in the jungle village of Chacala with dedicated land and an organic farm. Its core identity is a wellness/vacation resort rather than a meditation lineage institution, but it hosts a genuine, recurring, teacher-led Zen Rohatsu sesshin recognized within the Zen community -- included primarily for that program rather than the resort's general offerings.
schedule: Annual Rohatsu sesshin (December); other yoga/wellness retreats run monthly
cost: Full retreat packages from $1,895 (dorm) to $3,400 (ocean single) per stay

pricePerDay.notes: Derived from a ~7-night sesshin package, $1,895-$3,400 total, meals included.

foodNotes: Vegetarian/vegan/gluten-free plus fish/chicken options, organic farm-to-table.
